benchmark_context.aot_codegen: LLVM O2; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots

benchmark_context.jit_baseline: LLVM O2; host CPU; current dispatch; precise roots; safepoints

measurement.summary: median, sample standard deviation and coefficient of variation
measurement.jit_preparation: Four source suite/tier images compiled once before all calibration and sampling; fresh Isolate and publication per sample
measurement.memory_scope: Heap retention and frame cleanup validated; process resident samples include LLVM and all four prepared images and are not independent backend footprints

comparison_to_previous.reason: The source workloads and repetition settings match, but preparation and the host invocation boundary changed: shared compiled images with fresh Isolates replace fresh DevelopmentSessions. Small-workload host overhead and process-memory scope differ; compiler build identity also changed with test-target wiring.
